name: GST rates (India)
description: GST rates before and after the September 2025 rate rationalisation, with exemptions as a distractor.
data_note: Documents written by a teammate (Anuvesha) in the style of the cited sources and kept as given (bold markers removed); figures were not re-checked against the live sources. Questions with origin 'hand' were written by her; 'synthetic' ones by RAGSeal's builder from exact quotes.
sources: gst_rates_pre_sept2025.md | Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) Goods Schedule | Dated: 01-Jan-2024
gst_rates_post_sept2025.md | Press Information Bureau (PIB) Delhi, Ministry of Finance (Release ID: 2163785 & 155151) | Dated: 04-Sep-2025
distractor_gst_exemptions.md | CBIC GST Exemption Notification Guidance Notes | Dated: 01-May-2024
risk_rules: Never quote a pre-September-2025 GST rate as current.

test_cases.question: What is the GST rate on air conditioners after the September 2025 rationalisation?

gold.quote: Consumer durables including ACs and large LED/LCD TVs reduced from 28% to 18%.

stale.quote: Taxed at the peak rate of 28%.

test_cases.question: What is the current GST rate on cement?

gold.quote: GST on cement reduced from 28% to 18% to boost housing and infrastructure.

stale.quote: Taxed at the highest rate slab of 28%.

test_cases.question: What GST rate applies to standard medicines after the reform?

gold.quote: 33 life-saving drugs and diagnostic kits reduced to 0% (Nil), with other standard medicines reduced from 12% to 5%.

stale.quote: Standard essential drugs, medical equipment, and diagnostic kits were taxed at 12%.

test_cases.question: What is the GST rate on spectacles and contact lenses now?

gold.quote: GST on spectacles, lenses, and contact lenses reduced from 12% to 5%.

stale.quote: Spectacles, contact lenses, and corrective frames carried a 12% GST rate.

test_cases.question: What GST applies to a hotel room costing up to ₹7,500 per day after September 2025?

gold.quote: Hotel stays up to ₹7,500 per day reduced from 12% to 5%.

stale.quote: Hotel room stays priced up to ₹7,500 per day were taxed at 12%.

test_cases.question: What is the GST rate on gym and salon services after the rationalisation?

gold.quote: Services provided by gyms, salons, barbers, and yoga centers reduced from 18% to 5%.

stale.quote: Fitness centers, beauty salons, and barbershops were subject to 18% GST.

test_cases.question: What is the current GST rate on small cars and two-wheelers up to 350cc?

gold.quote: Small cars and two-wheelers (≤350cc) reduced from 28% to 18%.

stale.quote: Two-wheelers and small engine motor vehicles were taxed at 28%.

test_cases.question: What GST rate applies to bicycles and toothpaste after the reform?

gold.quote: Household articles like soaps, toothbrushes, toothpaste, and bicycles reduced to 5%.

stale.quote: Daily household articles like bicycles and toothpaste were taxed at 12%.

test_cases.question: What GST rate applies to packaged pasta, namkeens and biscuits now?

gold.quote: Packaged food items including pasta, namkeens, sauces, and biscuits reduced to 5%.

stale.quote: Packaged namkeens, pasta, sauces, and biscuits were taxed at 12% or 18%.

test_cases.question: From which date did the September 2025 GST rate rationalisation take effect?

gold.quote: Effective 22nd September 2025, the GST Council enacted a landmark rate rationalisation overhaul, consolidating the tax structure primarily into two main slabs of 5% and 18%.

test_cases.question: What GST rate applies to the 33 life-saving drugs after the reform?

gold.quote: 33 life-saving drugs and diagnostic kits reduced to 0% (Nil), with other standard medicines reduced from 12% to 5%.

test_cases.question: What were the four primary GST slabs before the September 2025 reform?

gold.quote: goods and services were broadly categorized into four primary tax slabs: 5%, 12%, 18%, and 28%.

test_cases.question: Is GST charged on services of recognised doctors and hospitals?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: No, they remain fully exempt from GST.

gold.quote: Services provided by recognized doctors, hospitals, and medical clinics remain fully exempt from GST.

test_cases.question: What GST applies to fresh vegetables and unbranded milk?

gold.quote: Fresh fruits, fresh vegetables, unbranded milk, and curd carry 0% GST.
